mirfield.s1_head: Kitting the events trade of Kirklees
s1loc: Mirfield sits on the Calder and Hebble Navigation in Kirklees, and its events year centres on the Mirfield Show at the Huddersfield Road showground, where the Mir'Fest Music Stage runs live bands through the August day. The Mirfield Arts Festival programmes installations along the Calder Valley waterways, while Parish Fest at Mirfield Parish Cricket Club and Hopton Mills Family Fest at Hopton Mills Cricket Club fill out a busy outdoor calendar across the town.

The trade here runs at two sizes. The showground operators and festival teams behind the Mirfield Show field large seasonal crews and buy through procurement, while independent stage crews, promoters and entertainers working Dewsbury, Batley and the wider Kirklees circuit want only a few branded pieces. A workwear supplier has to serve the agricultural-show operation and the single mobile crew alike, so trade accounts and direct online ordering run side by side.

Much of the work here is open-air and weather-led, which shapes the kit. Crews rigging the showground field, marshalling the canal-side cricket-club festivals or running the Mir'Fest stage need hi-vis for site safety, waterproofs for the Pennine summer and embroidered polos that mark out stewards and front-of-house at a glance. Seasonal intake peaks around the August show, when temporary crews are taken on quickly and kitted out in one branded run.
